svg.title: MailMind pipeline diagram
svg.desc: Flowchart showing the two parallel pipelines in MailMind: the sync/indexing pipeline on the left and the draft generation pipeline on the right, converging at the ChromaDB vector store.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does MailMind read the inbox.mbox file?')
sendPrompt('How does the mbox parser work in detail?')
sendPrompt('How does MailMind filter only user-authored emails?')
sendPrompt('What does the email cleaning pipeline remove?')
sendPrompt('What does the style analyzer extract from emails?')
sendPrompt('Which embedding model does MailMind use?')
sendPrompt('What fields are in the style profile JSON?')
sendPrompt('How does ChromaDB store and retrieve email embeddings?')
sendPrompt('What kinds of prompts work best with MailMind?')
sendPrompt('How is the user query embedded for retrieval?')
sendPrompt('How does the semantic retrieval engine rank results?')
sendPrompt('How does the prompt builder inject retrieved examples?')
sendPrompt('Which Ollama models work best for email generation?')
sendPrompt('How can I edit and copy the generated draft?')
